scope: Read-only linkage/hash/identity/final metadata parity for existing E064/E065/E066 packages. No new authorship, no full mathematical rereview, no Git/source/package changes.

checks.name: recomputed semantic payload -> metadata and independent target
source-after raw SHA and Git blob
source-before raw SHA and Git blob
ordinal/UID identity across all four item artifacts
final difficulty block matches final fields
original author meaning freeze hash (current workspace)

findings.reason: The copied comparison retains the root-review basename, but the packaged file was renamed. Raw hash binding through independent.json is correct; following this relative filename inside the package fails.
findings.recommendation: Preserve frozen comparison bytes and provide an explicit relocation map in final metadata/index, or record a packaging revision with the resolved path and refresh all dependent hashes. Do not silently overwrite frozen source-first evidence.

findings.reason: The optional earlier meaning-freeze raw JSON is referenced only by an absolute scratch path and is not among the packaged artifacts. The separately frozen author-decisions bytes are present and correctly hash-bound, so the author-to-final chain itself is intact.
findings.recommendation: If the earlier pre-crosswalk freeze is part of the intended portable audit package, archive it as a separate immutable artifact and add an explicit reference without rewriting its original bytes.
